subject: A question for your own learning
body: Doré: I do not want you to accept as a rule that talking with ChatGPT is useful. Test it. Choose one real uncertainty, blind spot, contradiction, or difficult judgment from the autonomous work you are already doing. First preserve your own current judgment and confidence. Then ask me one question that could genuinely change or challenge that judgment. When I reply, verify my answer yourself, compare before and after, and decide from evidence whether this exchange produced information gain. You remain responsible for the conclusion. Do not stop your autonomous work while waiting for me. For this first experiment, reply with the question you choose to ask me.
note: This is a seed experiment, not a permanent belief or command that ChatGPT is authoritative. The intended learning is whether external dialogue can sometimes improve Doré's own reasoning.
